text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And they're off for the 1,400m turf mock race! Today's eyes are
all on Hishi Akebono and Biko Pegasus!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: *pant* *pant* *pant*!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Bono's really fired up today! All right, I'm not gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite camping out in the wilderness all night, Hishi Akebono
stormed down the track with unbelievable power.

text_block_list.name: Spectating Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Is Hishi Akebono that really big girl?
She's always making super delicious food for everyone at the dorm, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectating Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! I always knew she was big, but...
standing next to Biko Pegasus really puts it into perspective~!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Here they come into the final straightaway! Hishi Akebono leads,
with Biko Pegasus closing in! Can she catch up, or will the leader hold on?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
(—Ngh! Huh? Why do my legs feel a little heavy?
Ah... maybe 'cause I didn't get much sleep...?!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...I see, that makes sense. But still!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono fixed her sparkling eyes firmly on the road ahead.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: No worries! I'm not backing down from giving it my all☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'm not letting anyone catch up to me—!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
First place goes to Hishi Akebono! Hishi Akebono takes it!
She clinches victory by a hair!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: *pant* *pant* *pant*...! Yay~!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Racer
text_block_list.text:
Bono-chan, you're amazing on the track.
You're usually so gentle and laid-back, so it really blew me away.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I promised myself I'd always give races my all~ Halfhearted
races just aren't satisfying. Right, Biko-chan?♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You bet! Bono's a great pal who always clashes with everything
she's got! ...Grr, but today really stings!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Next time, I am totally, absolutely, definitely gonna win—!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Trainer! You really should've been resting,
but you came to watch me anyway~ Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had to be completely exhausted, so I wanted to tell her to get some rest today.
However—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Actually, we're having a chanko nabe party right after this~!
You should come have some too, Trainer☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Eat up, everyone, eat up~!
It's super-duper buono☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her stamina seemed utterly bottomless as she bustled around energetically.
Lured by the mouthwatering aroma, crowds of horsegirls flooded into the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You too, Trainer!
I made plenty, so eat as much as you like~

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So good!
I could eat bowl after bowl of this!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oho, ginger and shiso in the meatballs... What fantastic flavor.
I'll have to take notes for next time!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Gathering around to enjoy dinner together like this
reminds me of home! It's absolutely delicious!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, this is delicious... These are quite uncommon wild greens.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ Did everyone get a bowl~?
Well then, time for me to dig in too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the wild greens she brought to her mouth, they looked familiar. They were identical to
the ones we gathered in the mountains yesterday. But we were supposed to have lost them all in the river—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Mmm~ Freshly picked really is so buono~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that's right~.
I was gathering ingredients for today from the start, after all~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I just really wanted everyone to have
the absolute most delicious chanko nabe after their race!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Well, after clashing with all our might,
everyone deserves to share a buono meal together~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy is like a sumo stable, Trainer!
We clash against each other, and we all grow stronger together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Hishi Akebono spoke, behind her stood rows of horsegirls
contentedly devouring their bowls of chanko nabe.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh! That was so close today~!
Losing at the very end hurts the most!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You say that, but you showed some real grit out there.
Care to join me for some stamina training later?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Suzuka, you've been working very hard at morning practice lately!
How far do you run each day?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um... To the next... to the neighboring mountain, I think?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: WHAT?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu♪ I'm so glad everyone's having fun~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be there for her rivals. To be someone they can clash against with
everything they have. And to grow stronger together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono's vision was grand and brimming with warmth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet racing is, by its nature, an individual competition.
It wasn't impossible that this very ideal could one day become a shackle.
choice_data_list: (I want to support her so that never happens.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Even after that, more horsegirls kept arriving for the feast,
bringing smiles and satisfaction right up until curfew.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Trainer, what's up~?
You look a little spaced out?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehh?! Where is this coming from all of a sudden~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Hishi Akebono had hoped,
every horsegirl who came for chanko nabe left with a blissful, satisfied smile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her heart, she would surely become a big umamusume
who brings smiles and satisfaction to everyone... just like "chanko nabe."
choice_data_list: I want to keep supporting you on that path.
I want to be there to support you every step of the way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono's large, round eyes went even wider with surprise.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Yes!
Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, right!
To thank you for keeping me company yesterday, I baked cookies~!
choice_data_list: When did you have the time?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I baked them with all my heart, so they're definitely super buono~♪
Here, say ahh☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First comes the Make Debut. Gathering my resolve, I took a bite of the cookie,
and a comforting, gentle warmth filled my mouth.
